# Figure 3

## Panel B

```{r process_umap_panelB, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
Idents(mergedALL) <- "dataset"

dataset_colors <- list(
  dib   = "#e49d6b",
  Loo   = "#c46966",
  marcy = "#7da7ad"
)

umap_function <- function(sample, dataset, color) {
  SCpubr::do_DimPlot(
    sample = sample,
    cells.highlight = WhichCells(sample, expression = dataset == !!dataset),
    colors.use = color
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste("Cluster:", dataset)) +
    cowplot::theme_half_open() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    NoLegend()
}

p_dib   <- umap_function(mergedALL, "dib", dataset_colors$dib)
p_loo   <- umap_function(mergedALL, "Loo", dataset_colors$Loo)
p_marcy <- umap_function(mergedALL, "marcy", dataset_colors$marcy)

p_dib
p_loo
p_marcy
```

## Panel D

```{r Violin_plot_markers, echo =  FALSE}

new_order <- c("Oligo",
               "ImAstro",
               "qNSCs",
               "aNSCs",
               "NP",
               "RG",
               "Neuroblasts",
               "CR")
mergedALL$new_ident <- factor(mergedALL$new_ident, levels = new_order)

features_of_interest <- unique(c(
  "Olig2", "Sox10", "Pdgfra",
  "Aldh1l1","Gfap", "Aqp4", "Glul",
  "Hopx", "Id4",
  "Mki67",
  "Neurog2", 
  "Nes", "Pax6",
  "Nes","Vim","Ccnb1","Cdk1","Tubb3",
  "Rtn1", "Dcx","Reln",
  "Trp73"
))

# Retrieve data for all genes and clusters 
data <- FetchData(mergedALL, vars = c(features_of_interest, "new_ident"))

data_long <- pivot_longer(data,
                          cols = all_of(features_of_interest),
                          names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene,
                       levels = features_of_interest))

# Violin plot 
violin_plot <- ggplot(data_long,
            aes(x = new_ident,
                y = Expression,
                fill = new_ident)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width",
              trim = FALSE,
              adjust = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left", scales = "free_y") +
theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  
  panel.background = element_blank(), 
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 22),
  strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 22, face = "bold"),
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  legend.position = "none",
  panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines")
)

violin_plot
```

## Panel F

```{r slingshot_lineages, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo = FALSE}

colorsgd <- c("#F7FCC9", "#A9DCB8", "#2459A5", "#14152F")

# UMAP embeddings & Slingshot
umap.embeddings <- Embeddings(Cajal, reduction = "umap.pca", verbose = FALSE)
slingshot.obj   <- slingshot(
  umap.embeddings,
  clusterLabels = Cajal$pca_clusters,
  start.clus    = 0
)

# Assign pseudotime
Cajal$pseudotime <- slingPseudotime(slingshot.obj)[, 1]

# Data for plotting 
plot_data <- data.frame(
  UMAP_1     = umap.embeddings[, 1],
  UMAP_2     = umap.embeddings[, 2],
  Cluster    = Cajal$pca_clusters,
  Pseudotime = Cajal$pseudotime
)

# Base UMAP plot
pseudotime <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Pseudotime), size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, name = "Pseudotime") +
  labs(
    title    = "UMAP with Slingshot Lineages",
    x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", color = "Pseudotime"
  ) +
  theme(
    base_size       = 15,
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title      = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text       = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.line       = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# Adding overlay lineage curves
for (curve in slingCurves(slingshot.obj)) {
  curve_data <- as.data.frame(curve$s)
  colnames(curve_data) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  
  pseudotime <- pseudotime + geom_path(
    data = curve_data,
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2),
    color = "black", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8,
    lineend = "round", linetype = "dashed"
  )
}


pseudotime <- pseudotime + annotate(
  "text",
  x = max(plot_data$UMAP_1) - 20,
  y = max(plot_data$UMAP_2) - 4,
  label = "Key Lineage Path",
  size = 5, color = "black", hjust = 0
)

pseudotime

## Optional save
# ggsave("C:/Users/raine/Desktop/Analyse/Results/cajal_umap_lineage.pdf", pseudotime, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)

```

# Figure 4

## Panel A

```{r cellchat_bmp_signaling, error=FALSE, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Extract BMP matrix
bmp_mat <- cellchat@netP$prob[, , "BMP"]

rownames(bmp_mat) <- gsub("&", ".", rownames(bmp_mat))
colnames(bmp_mat) <- gsub("&", ".", colnames(bmp_mat))
rownames(bmp_mat) <- gsub(" ", "_", rownames(bmp_mat))
colnames(bmp_mat) <- gsub(" ", "_", colnames(bmp_mat))

# Define cluster colors
cluster_colors <- c(
  # Oligodendrocytes
  Loo_Oligo = "#ffa600",
  dib_Oligo = "#ffa600",
  marcy_Oligos = "#ffa600",
  
  # Astrocytes
  Loo_Astro_i1 = "#225EA8",
  Loo_Astro_i2 = "#225EA8",
  dib_Astro = "#225EA8",
  marcy_Astrocytes = "#225EA8",
  
  # C&Rc
  dib_C.Rc = "#fecc00",
  Loo_C.Rc_P = "#fecc00",
  Loo_C.Rc_E = "#f6ef5f",
  
  # Radial glia and SVZ lineages
  Loo_RG1 = "#1D91C0",
  Loo_RG2 = "#1D91C0",
  Loo_RG3 = "#1D91C0",
  Loo_RG4 = "#1D91C0",
  Loo_SVZ1_mig_P = "#1D91C0",
  Loo_SVZ2_migrating = "#1D91C0",
  Loo_SVZ2_SVZ_E = "#1D91C0",
  Loo_SVZ3_Pro_E = "#1D91C0",
  
  # Progenitors / NSCs
  dib_progenitors = "#7FCDBB",
  dib_AP = "#7FCDBB",
  marcy_aNSCs = "#7FCDBB",
  marcy_TAPs = "#7FCDBB",
  marcy_qNSCs = "#7FCDBB"
)

# Define desired order
my_order <- c(
  # Oligo
  "Loo_Oligo", "dib_Oligo", "marcy_Oligos",
  
  # Astro
  "Loo_Astro_i1", "Loo_Astro_i2", "dib_Astro", "marcy_Astrocytes",
  
  # C&Rc
  "dib_C.Rc", "Loo_C.Rc_P", "Loo_C.Rc_E",
  
  # RG / SVZ
  "Loo_RG1", "Loo_RG2", "Loo_RG3", "Loo_RG4",
  "Loo_SVZ1_mig_P", "Loo_SVZ2_migrating", "Loo_SVZ2_SVZ_E", "Loo_SVZ3_Pro_E",
  
  # Progenitors
  "dib_progenitors", "dib_AP", "marcy_aNSCs", "marcy_TAPs", "marcy_qNSCs"
)

# Subset to only existing rows/cols 
valid_order <- intersect(my_order, rownames(bmp_mat))
bmp_mat <- bmp_mat[valid_order, valid_order]

# Create annotations
annotation_row <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(valid_order, levels = valid_order))
annotation_col <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(valid_order, levels = valid_order))
rownames(annotation_row) <- valid_order
rownames(annotation_col) <- valid_order
ann_colors <- list(Cluster = cluster_colors)

heatmap_cellchat <- pheatmap(
  bmp_mat,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_row = annotation_row,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#e4f0e8", "#45BF55", "#044D29", "#00261C"))(100),
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "BMP Signaling Targets"
)

heatmap_cellchat

# Optionally save
# pdf("C:/Users/raine/Desktop/Analyse/Results/BMP_Signaling_Heatmap.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
#     draw(heatmap_cellchat)
#     dev.off()
```

### Panel B

```{r histogram_count_cell, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
# Count cells per dataset
cell_counts <- table(mergedALL$dataset) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(cell_counts) <- c("dataset", "count")

# Calculate percentage
cell_counts <- cell_counts %>%
  mutate(percent = count / sum(count) * 100,
         label = paste0(round(percent, 1), "%"))

# Plot with percentage labels inside bars
count <- ggplot(cell_counts, aes(x = dataset, y = count, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = 1.5, size = 5, color = "black") +  # Adjust vjust for position inside bar
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("dib" = "#E6897C", "Loo" = "#F2D699", "marcy" = "#c2edf7")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 17) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Number of cells per dataset", x = NULL, y = "Cell count")
```

```{r celltype_umap_highlight, echo = FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE}
  "marcy_P2_qNSCs"          = "#c2edf7",
  "marcy_P2_Astro"          = "#c2edf7"
)

make_umap <- function(highlight, title, file) {
  colors <- base_colors
  colors[names(highlight)] <- highlight

  p <- SCpubr::do_DimPlot(
    mergedALL2,
    reduction   = "umap.unintegrated",
    pt.size     = 0.5,
    colors.use  = colors
  ) +
    theme_classic() +
    NoLegend() +
    ggtitle(title) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

  # ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 3, height = 3, units = "in", dpi = 600)
  return(p)
}
```

### Panel H to J 

```{r Quality_control, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}

DefaultAssay(LooP0E14)    <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(dibellasubset) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(marcysubP2b) <- "RNA"

LooP0E14$dataset    <- "LooP0E14"
dibellasubset$dataset <- "dibellasubset"
marcysubP2b$dataset <- "marcysubP2b"

add_qc_metrics <- function(obj) {
  obj$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(obj$nFeature_RNA) / log10(obj$nCount_RNA)
  obj$mitoRatio        <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "(?i)^mt-") / 100
  return(obj)
}

LooP0E14    <- add_qc_metrics(LooP0E14)
dibellasubset <- add_qc_metrics(dibellasubset)
marcysubP2b <- add_qc_metrics(marcysubP2b)

extract_metadata <- function(obj, dataset_name) {
  md <- obj@meta.data
  col_to_use <- if ("orig.ident" %in% colnames(md)) "orig.ident" else "orig_ident"
  md <- md %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c("nCount_RNA", col_to_use, "log10GenesPerUMI", "mitoRatio", "nFeature_RNA")))
  md$cell_id <- seq_len(nrow(md))
  md$dataset <- dataset_name
  return(md)
}

metadata_combined <- bind_rows(
  extract_metadata(LooP0E14, "LooP0E14"),
  extract_metadata(dibellasubset, "dibellasubset"),
  extract_metadata(marcysubP2b, "marcysubP2b")
) %>%
  mutate(dataset_origin = dataset) %>%
  filter(nCount_RNA > 0, nFeature_RNA > 0, mitoRatio > 0)

dataset_colors <- c(
  "dibellasubset" = "#ffb5ab",
  "marcysubP2b"   = "#c2edf7",
  "LooP0E14"      = "#e9d8a6"
)

qc_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.box      = "horizontal"
  )

plot_density <- function(xvar, xlab, title, log_scale = FALSE) {
  g <- ggplot(metadata_combined, aes_string(x = xvar, color = "dataset_origin", fill = "dataset_origin")) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Density", title = title, color = "Dataset") +
    scale_color_manual(values = dataset_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = dataset_colors, guide = "none") +
    qc_theme
  if (log_scale) g <- g + scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma_format())
  return(g)
}

P <- plot_density("nCount_RNA", "Number of RNA Counts (log scale)", "Distribution of RNA Counts", log_scale = TRUE)
Q <- plot_density("log10GenesPerUMI", "log10 Genes per UMI", "Distribution of log10 Genes per UMI")
R <- plot_density("mitoRatio", "Mitochondrial Ratio", "Distribution of Mito Ratio", log_scale = TRUE)

J <- ggplot(metadata_combined, aes(x = nFeature_RNA, color = dataset_origin)) +
  geom_density(size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Number of Features (Genes)", y = "Density",
       title = "Distribution of Detected Genes per Cell", color = "Dataset") +
  scale_color_manual(values = dataset_colors) +
  qc_theme

P + Q + R + J
```

```{r markers_svz, echo = FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE}
selected_genes <- list(
  qNSCs = c("Hopx", "Sox9", "Id4"),
  aNSCs = c("Mki67", "Ascl1", "Sox2"),
  Oligo = c("Cntn1", "Olig2", "Olig1"),

  CR = c("Reln", "Ebf3", "Trp73"),
  Neuroblasts = c("Dcx", "Tubb3", "Stmn2"),
  RG = c("Hes1", "Vim", "Pax6")
)
Idents(mergedALL) = "new_ident"
colors <- c(
"qNSCs" = "#003f5c",
"aNSCs" = "#C7E9B4",
"Oligo" = "#ffa600",
"NP" = "#7FCDBB",
"ImAstro" = "#225EA8",
"CR" = "#fecc00",
"Neuroblasts" = "#e8f5a2",
"RG" = "#1D91C0"
)
# General UMAP
general_umap <- DimPlot(
mergedALL,
reduction = "umap",
cols = colors,label.box = T,
label.size = 6,
label = TRUE,
repel = TRUE,
pt.size = 0.7
)  +
theme_cowplot() +
ggtitle("New_ident_based on clustersubtype")+
labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + 
theme(
axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
axis.text = element_blank() 
)+
  coord_fixed()+ NoLegend() 

# Update FeaturePlot function to enlarge all text
make_feature_plots <- function(genes, cluster_color) {
  plots <- list()
  for (gene in genes) {
    if (gene %in% rownames(mergedALL)) {
      p <- FeaturePlot(
        mergedALL,
        features = gene,
        reduction = "umap",
        cols = c("lightgrey", cluster_color),
        pt.size = 1
      ) +
        ggtitle(gene) +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 24),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
        ) +
        coord_fixed()
      plots[[gene]] <- p
    }
  }
  return(plots)
}

all_rows <- list()

first_cluster <- names(selected_genes)[1]
first_fplots <- make_feature_plots(selected_genes[[first_cluster]], colors[first_cluster])
first_row <- general_umap | first_fplots[[1]] | first_fplots[[2]] | first_fplots[[3]]
all_rows[[1]] <- first_row

remaining_clusters <- names(selected_genes)[-1]
for (cluster_name in remaining_clusters) {
  genes <- selected_genes[[cluster_name]]
  cluster_color <- colors[cluster_name]
  
  fplots <- make_feature_plots(genes, cluster_color)
  row <- plot_spacer() | fplots[[1]] | fplots[[2]] | fplots[[3]]
  all_rows[[cluster_name]] <- row
}

num_rows <- length(all_rows)
row_heights <- rep(2, num_rows) 

final_figure <- wrap_plots(all_rows, ncol = 1, heights = row_heights)
```

```{r gene_expression_pseudotime, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE}
pseudotime <- slingPseudotime(slingshot.obj)
Cajal[["RNA"]] <- as(object = Cajal[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay")
Bmpr1a_expression <- Cajal@assays$RNA@data["Bmpr1a", ]
Bmpr2_expression <- Cajal@assays$RNA@data["Bmpr2", ]
Bmp5_expression <- Cajal@assays$RNA@data["Bmp5", ]
Bmp7_expression <- Cajal@assays$RNA@data["Bmp7", ]
Casp3_expression <- Cajal@assays$RNA@data["Casp3", ]
Bax_expression <- Cajal@assays$RNA@data["Bax", ]
Casp9_expression <- Cajal@assays$RNA@data["Casp9", ]

gene_list <- list(
"Bmpr1a" = Bmpr1a_expression,
"Bmpr2" = Bmpr2_expression,
"Bmp5" = Bmp5_expression,
"Bmp7" = Bmp7_expression,
"Casp3" = Casp3_expression,
"Casp9" = Casp9_expression,
"Bax" = Bax_expression
)

# Add these expression vectors to plot_data for easier ggplot use
for (gene in names(gene_list)) {
plot_data[[paste0(gene, "_expression")]] <- gene_list[[gene]]
}
# Create the list of plots
plot_list <- lapply(names(gene_list), function(gene) {
ggplot(plot_data, aes_string(x = "pseudotime", y = paste0(gene, "_expression"))) +
geom_point(aes(color = pseudotime), size = 1.5) +
scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("grey90", "grey30")) +
geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "black") +
xlab("Pseudotime") +
ylab(paste("Expression of", gene)) +
theme_cowplot()
})
plot_list

# Combine all plots into a grid (auto layout)
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list)

combined_plot
```
